interpretation: This is a read-only description of NeoBabylon exposure and selected-tuple evidence. Upstream source presence is not provider support or permission. A recorded qualification means only the exact scoped run stated in that model capability record; Unknown is never promoted by inference.

items.name: App Server tool activity
items.description: Selected tool, patch, MCP, and function-output events can appear in conversation activity. There is no complete catalog or per-tool enablement screen.

exposure.label: Selected activity only
exposure.permissionSource: Codex App Server owns tool execution and approval. The effective authority for this session is shown in Runtime diagnostics; the P3-02 per-operation failure matrix remains open.

items.name: Browser/computer execution
items.description: WebView2 renders NeoBabylon itself; it is not a model browser or computer-use operation.

exposure.label: Not exposed
exposure.permissionSource: No NeoBabylon callable operation exists for this category.

items.name: Image input (view_image)
items.description: There is no product image picker or screenshot capture. Upstream image-tool availability alone does not prove this selected model can consume an image.

exposure.label: No product image surface
exposure.permissionSource: No NeoBabylon image-picker or screenshot operation is exposed; model-directed tools still use the selected App Server authority.

items.name: Saved tool-output paging
items.description: The UI can inspect bounded ranges of an existing saved App Server output. This is not an arbitrary-document reader, and omitted source text may not be recoverable.

exposure.label: Saved output only
exposure.permissionSource: Read-only inspection of the selected saved App Server item; it does not grant a new file-read operation.
exposure.evidenceSource: docs/release/VERIFICATION.md — P2-11 bounded native large-output; docs/WIP/PHASE3-5_VERTICAL_SLICES.md — P3-04

qualification.evidenceSource: This is a host/UI inspection behavior, not a provider/model capability.

items.name: Conversation-history filtering
items.description: The UI filters loaded saved-history pages; it does not search arbitrary workspace files.

exposure.label: UI history filter
exposure.permissionSource: Local saved-history view only; no model tool or workspace authority is added.

qualification.evidenceSource: This is a local UI filter, not a provider/model search capability.

items.name: Workspace/web search tool
items.description: No NeoBabylon workspace-search UI is exposed; provider web-search behavior is unqualified.

exposure.label: Not exposed
exposure.permissionSource: No NeoBabylon search-tool operation is exposed.

items.name: Patch application (apply_patch)
items.description: App Server-backed patch activity and review are rendered. A provider's generic tool-use flag is not sufficient to qualify this wire format.

exposure.label: Existing App Server operation
exposure.permissionSource: Codex App Server owns execution and any review/approval; the effective authority is shown above. Broader denial and failure cases remain open.

items.name: Model-directed command (exec_command)
items.description: A command can be requested through an ordinary App Server turn. There is no product shell panel; thread/shellCommand remains human-only.

exposure.label: Existing App Server operation
exposure.permissionSource: Selected App Server thread authority. NeoBabylon currently uses the explicitly selected unrestricted policy; this is full Windows-user authority, not workspace containment.

items.name: Effective context display
items.description: The selected record and Runtime diagnostics show provider and Codex effective context evidence separately.

exposure.label: Read-only metadata
exposure.permissionSource: No execution authority is granted by this display.

items.name: Automatic compaction behavior
items.description: The pinned runtime contains automatic compaction. NeoBabylon does not expose a manual compact control, and live-provider triggering is not qualified.

exposure.label: No control; runtime-managed
exposure.permissionSource: Runtime-managed behavior; no NeoBabylon control is exposed.

qualification.evidenceSource: Only deterministic synthetic-context evidence is recorded; live-provider threshold and cross-model behavior are unqualified.

items.name: Skill discovery and execution
items.description: The upstream runtime contains skill-loading code. NeoBabylon exposes no skill catalog or skill-specific operation.

exposure.label: Not exposed
exposure.permissionSource: No NeoBabylon skill-management operation is exposed; activation state remains Unknown.

items.name: Hook activation and dispatch
items.description: Upstream hook code exists, but current activation and configuration provenance are unknown. NeoBabylon exposes no hook catalog or control.

exposure.label: Not exposed
exposure.permissionSource: No NeoBabylon hook-management operation is exposed.

items.name: MCP call activity
items.description: Existing App Server-backed call activity may be rendered; this does not discover, configure, or authenticate a server.

exposure.label: Activity only
exposure.permissionSource: App Server execution authority applies to an existing configured server. NeoBabylon does not expose configuration or authentication.

items.name: MCP discovery and setup
items.description: Server discovery, setup, status, and authentication are not available in the product UI.

exposure.label: Not exposed
exposure.permissionSource: No NeoBabylon MCP-management operation is exposed.

items.name: Plugin install and enablement
items.description: No NeoBabylon plugin catalog, install, or enable operation is exposed. Installed upstream state is unknown.

exposure.label: Not exposed
exposure.permissionSource: No NeoBabylon plugin-management operation is exposed. Packaging/install work is separately deferred.

items.name: Dynamic tool registration
items.description: Registration is experimental in the pinned protocol and remains off in NeoBabylon's selected stable protocol. A rendered dynamic-tool event does not enable registration.

exposure.label: Experimental · off
exposure.permissionSource: No registration or hot-reload operation is exposed; enabling it requires a separate opt-in and qualification decision.
